entities.name: Johann Gottlieb Graun
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Gottlieb Graun was a German Baroque/Classical era composer and violinist, born in Wahrenbrück. His brother Carl Heinrich was a singer and also a composer, and is the better known of the two.
